title: PR pytest-run holds 12 of 20 runner slots for ~40 min each
note: From GH-CAPACITY-INFRA-FIRST. MEASURED 08:24Z: 12 of 20 in-progress jobs were pytest-run on 12 distinct PRs (already superseded per PR number, so this is real fan-out, not stacking). Full suite ~22.7k tests, 33-48 min (pytest-run.yml timeout note). Options to evaluate without weakening the gate: run the full suite only in merge_group/at arm time, or a cheaper PR tier for data-only automation/** PRs (research receipts/results) -- required-check semantics must be preserved (a path-filtered required check stays pending). Rerun: count in_progress jobs by workflow via gh api runs?status=in_progress + jobs.  | MEASURED 2026-10-15 (pytest-run, runs created in the 24h before 08:30Z, n=467, ~5,779 run-wall-min = ~4 runner slots continuous): PR success non-automation 94 runs / 2,283 min (40%); push-main success 87 / 1,114 (19%); PR CANCELLED (superseded) 108 / 1,052 (18%); automation/** PR success 98 / 770 (13%, already on the data-only fast path, ~8 min each); remainder in-progress/failure. Required contexts today (branch-protection-sync.yml): pytest-collect, pytest-run, guards. PROPOSAL FOR MANAGER (HOLD: changes what the required pytest-run context means on a PR, so not self-landed): (P1) on pull_request, pytest-run runs the AFFECTED tests only -- extend scripts/ci/pytest_run_scope.py (it already selects data-reading tests for data-only diffs) with an import-graph selection for code diffs, falling back to the FULL suite when the diff touches conftest, requirements, src/ shared modules above a fan-in threshold, or the selector cannot decide; the full suite keeps running on every push to main (already non-cancelling, per-sha grading) and on merge_group. Context NAMES stay identical, so no protection edit. Expected: most of the 40% + 18% PR share drops to minutes; risk: a cross-module break merges and is caught post-merge on main, not pre-merge. (P2, no semantic change, can self-land): debounce -- the PR job first sleeps ~90 s and exits if the PR head moved (cancel-in-progress already kills it, but it has by then installed deps); measured cost of superseded PR runs 1,052 min/24h. Decision needed: P1 yes/no.
